title.headline: Thirty product lines. Five days per answer.

end.line: Quillon for Aurelia Insurance’s claims legal team

vo: Aurelia's claims team answers coverage questions across thirty product lines, and each one takes five working days.
Ask Quillon one question across every policy wording in the matter, and it reads them all at once.
The answer comes back cited to the page, with each wording's clause quoted beside it.
Then the coverage opinion is redlined in Word, to your team's standard positions.
Marcus will walk your team through it on Thursday the twentieth.
